title: Administration Central Provincial Local
definition: The multi-tiered structural evolution of British-Indian administration encompassing central autocratic control, provincial decentralization experiments, and local self-government institutions from 1773 to 1947.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims through statutory evolution (Regulating Act to Government of India Act 1935) and in Mains GS-1/GS-2 for tracing the roots of Indian federalism, local governance, and bureaucratic machinery.
learningOutcomes: Master the chronological evolution of central, provincial, and local administrative tiers under British rule.
Evaluate financial devolution schemes (Mayo, Lytton, Ripon) and statutory reforms (1861, 1892, 1909, 1919, 1935).
Apply high-yield mnemonics to tackle complex match-the-following and chronological Prelims questions.
prerequisites: British expansion and consolidation in India
